one_liner: Mailchimp Marketing API v3 is a broad REST API with self-serve API keys and OAuth 2 app registration on a free account; Mailchimp also publishes an official MCP server (for its Transactional/Mandrill API) plus a docs-search MCP, with community servers covering the Marketing API.
auth_notes: Authorization-code OAuth 2 is available. Apps are registered self-serve on the Registered Apps page. Tokens don't expire and there is no refresh token. API keys and OAuth tokens can be sent as HTTP Basic (token as password) or as a Bearer header. The data center prefix (dc) is needed for the API host.
access_notes: An account lets you get an API key and register an OAuth app. What the API can do depends on the plan level (e.g. Templates API read-only on free plans). Marketplace listing needs 25+ active users, but that is not required to build or use the API.
blocker_notes: No blocker. Account gives an API key and OAuth app registration.

evidence.quote: Mailchimp implements the standard [authorization code flow]
Registering gives you the `client_id` and `client_secret` your server needs.
You can either use HTTP Basic Authentication or Bearer Authentication.
If you don’t have a Mailchimp account already, you’ll need to [create one](https://login.mailchimp.com/signup/) in order to use the API.
Once you have an account and are logged in, you can [get an API key]
The root url for the API is `https://<dc>.api.mailchimp.com/3.0/`.
Our MCP specifically allows you to interact with the Transactional Messaging API
Draft, test, and send Mailchimp campaigns straight from your MCP client
